Project Board

Plan project work, document progress and assess outcomes inside a Moodle course.

Project Board brings a Kanban-style workspace to individual assignments, Moodle groups and shared class projects. Students can follow connected tasks while teachers keep project organization and assessment close to the rest of the course.

Project work in Moodle
  • Individual, group or collective boards.
  • Tasks, checklists, assignments and dependencies.
  • Comments, evidence and task history.
  • Assessment and activity completion.
Visible project progress
Use Kanban columns and work-in-progress limits to follow assignments through planning, execution and completion.
Evidence and teamwork
Organize responsibilities, attach evidence and discuss task details while retaining a history of project activity.
Teacher assessment
Choose project, individual or criteria-based grading options and use Moodle's gradebook and completion capabilities.
Make the project process part of learning

In a research assignment, students may organize data collection, analysis, writing and review as connected tasks. Dependencies and checklists clarify what must happen next, while due dates and evidence help show how the work developed.

Teachers choose whether learners work individually, in Moodle groups or on a shared board, and can limit who creates, moves or assigns tasks. Group access follows the course permissions, so visibility and editing rights are not the same thing.

Release maturity: Project Board is currently beta. Validate the intended group, grading, completion and backup workflows before using it for production-critical assessment.
